name: L6 Game host: the platformer runs
body: The Nox wrapper over the Nyx C API and `game-host`: every `lantern:::` function in `docs/game-api.md`, the hooks (`OnFixedUpdate`, `OnUpdate`, `OnRender`) and `HeadlessRenderer`.

acceptance_criteria.text: The platformer runs unchanged on the Nox engine
The headless game trace matches the Rust engine's within the tolerance
Speed against the Rust build is measured and recorded
Dean runs it on his Mac

definition_of_done.text: PR into the port's branch, reviewed, with the milestone's checks passing
